_about: What each combat skill's icon (skill bar, skill book, altar) shows, for Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_item_icons.py --set skills: painted whole in LocalSpawn's "Skill Icon dark" style, opaque, default model Chroma1-HD (the user's picks, 2026-11-25; Troll's Hurl was Qwen-Image 2512). Each line is the prompt its icon was made from.
AshladsEmber: A battered iron tinderbox held open in a calloused hand, a roaring cone of orange embers, sparks and flame bursting out of it toward the viewer. Warm amber firelight against a cold dark night.
FrostRune: The Isa rune, a single upright stroke, carved glowing pale icy blue into the frozen air. A jagged spear of ice bursts out of the rune and shoots forward, frost shards breaking off along its length. Dark winter night and swirling snow behind.
HeartrootsGrasp: Thick gnarled tree roots erupting from cracked forest earth, twisting upward like grasping claws around the viewer, a faint sickly green glow in the cracks of the bark. Dark old pines and mist behind.
HuldrasBlessing: The huldra, a beautiful forest spirit woman with long hair and a cow's tail hidden in her cloak, half hidden among birch trunks, holding out cupped hands of soft green-gold healing light. Leaves and motes of light drift around her hands. Deep forest shadows behind.
TrollsbaneWrath: A massive iron warhammer slamming down onto the ground, gripped in two armoured fists, the stone cracking open in a ring around the head of the hammer, a shockwave of dust, shards of rock and sparks bursting outward. The hammer fills the picture, seen from a low angle. Dirty ochre dust and a hot amber flash at the point of impact.
WhirlingSteel: A Norse warrior spinning with a sword held out at arm's length, a full blurred circle of steel slash trails around him, sparks flying where the arc cuts through the air, his cloak swirling. Seen from slightly above, cold steel-blue light on the blade.
WolfsLunge: A snarling grey wolf of the north in mid-leap, lunging straight at the viewer with jaws wide open and long fangs bared, forelegs reaching, fur bristling along its back. Blood-red accent on the fangs and a few drops in the air. Dark pine forest and cold mist behind.
MountainLeap: A heavy-built Norse warrior crashing down from a high leap onto rocky mountain ground, both feet and a two-handed iron hammer driving into the stone. The rock cracks outward in a ring, chunks of stone and dust thrown up around him. Grey peaks and snow mist behind.
WeaponArt: A sword and a bearded axe crossed in a burst of power, their edges glowing with hot ember light, curved streaks of motion sweeping around them as if mid-strike. Sparks and dark smoke behind.
RuneArt: A sword blade engraved with glowing Norse runes along its fuller, a small carved rune stone set into the crossguard, pale blue rune light bleeding from the carvings and curling like smoke around the steel. Dark stone and mist behind.
WarCry: A bearded Viking warrior roaring with his mouth wide open and head thrust forward, veins standing out, his breath steaming in the cold air. A round wooden shield on his arm. Rings of force ripple outward from the roar, shaking the air. Warm amber light on his face against a dark stormy sky.
TrollsHurl: A huge grey-skinned arm hurling a rough boulder the size of a head straight toward the viewer, rock chips and dust trailing behind it, motion streaks. A misty troll valley with dark crags far behind.
WintersBreath: A hooded Norse warrior seen in profile, exhaling a long cone of freezing breath, frost crystals and snow swirling outward and turning the air to ice. Pale icy blue light, dark snowy mountain pass behind.
CrossingCut: A notched viking sword slashing twice through the air in a bright X, two crossing arcs of steel light, droplets of dark red blood flung from the edge. Dusk-grey sky behind.
OpenTheVein: In deep shadow, a slim seax dagger driving point-first into a dark armoured shape, a burst of deep red blood flaring outward in a crimson flower, the blade wet and gleaming. Pitch-black night forest fills the whole background, no white.
ShieldSplitter: A bearded iron axe chopping down through a round wooden viking shield, the planks splitting apart and iron rivets flying, splinters bursting outward. Smoky battlefield haze behind.
ReapingArc: A huge two-handed greataxe sweeping in a wide horizontal arc, a long crescent trail of light and blood spray behind its edge like a scythe through grain. Stormy dusk sky behind.
HeadsmansDrop: A great two-handed sword falling point-down in an executioner's overhead blow, cracking through a broken iron helmet, sparks and shards of armour flying. Dark stone and torchlight behind.
Earthbreaker: A heavy stone-headed war maul crashing into the ground among twisted tree roots, the earth heaving up in jagged slabs and the roots snapping, a ring of dust and stones. Grey morning behind.
RunThrough: A long ash-wood spear thrusting straight toward the viewer, its leaf-shaped iron point driving through a cowering shadowy foe, a streak of motion behind the shaft. Misty field behind.
RibBreaker: A bare-knuckled boot kick driving hard into a shadowy ribcage, a shockwave ring and flying spittle, cracked bones suggested in white lines. Dark tavern-brown haze behind.
KindlingBolt: A carved runic wooden staff with a glowing tip loosing a small spinning bolt of orange fire and cinders that streaks forward, trailing smoke. Dark night sky behind.
HuntersSnare: A hunter's rope snare with stone weights whirling through the air and wrapping tight around a beast's legs, the cords taut and dust kicked up. Autumn forest edge behind.
Wildfire: Burning embers scattered on dark earth suddenly erupting into a towering burst of roaring orange flame, sparks and burning ash spiralling upward. Black starless night sky fills the whole background, deep shadows, no white.
Hoarfrost: A burst of hoarfrost spreading outward in a ring across dark ground, white frost crystals and feathery ice climbing up blades of grass, a pale blue glow at its centre. Winter night behind.
ElfShot: A tiny glowing elf-arrow of pale green light, thin as a needle, flying out of a birch wood at dusk, leaving a trail of faint sparkling motes and a soft eerie glow. Misty birches behind.
Fimbulwinter: A colossal ring of jagged blue ice spikes erupting from frozen ground around a lone cloaked warrior, a howling white blizzard spiralling up into a black winter sky, frost crystals glittering. Dark night fills the whole background, no white.
SurtrsBrand: A gigantic burning sword of molten fire striking down from a black smoky sky into the earth, a dome of roaring orange flame and embers bursting outward from the impact, cracks of glowing lava in the ground. Dark night fills the whole background.
RavensMark: A black raven with glowing pale eyes diving forward, trailing dark feathers and faint violet runic light, a glowing rune mark hanging in the air before it. Misty dark pine forest behind, deep shadows.
BearHide: A snarling great brown bear's head and pelt worn as a hood over a warrior's shoulders, the fur bristling with a faint amber glow, claw marks gouged in wood beside it. Dark forest behind, deep shadows.
